scope: Independent read-only source and persisted metadata review. No tests, model/channel/metric call, production prepare, or runtime mutation executed by reviewer.

resolved_finding.summary: Hostless T1B/T1C history must only be checked on pinned original host.
resolved_finding.resolution: prepare now validates the exact pinned diagnosis and requires current nodename to equal diagnosis.observer_host before any lineage.build or historical PID checks, for both B2 and B3. A new targeted fixture checks main passes, leo rejects, and diagnosis mutation rejects.

checked_contracts: Three exact admitted schemas: 6540 original inline members,332 T1B ACTUAL_NEW,75 T1C ACTUAL_NEW; unknown member/schema/origin rejected.

T1B/T1C bindings include actual closed receiver maps, per-image source-decode/render evidence, header/profile/payload, actual terminated bit length, raw-bit SHA and packed-byte SHA, source endpoint and frozen model/runtime/numerical identity.
T1C array key and slot are validated on saved image-index metadata; no nonexistent image_key is required in per-image evidence.

The adapter does not fabricate missing inline identity or copy TX truth into RX data. Its explicit revision proof sits beside cache metadata. Original verified_candidate still verifies real source-wire bytes and actual image arrays/hashes.
T1B actual native identity is newly pinned against closed registration and runtime, with no false historical publication claim; T1C published identity copy is additionally checked.

B2 accepts exactly original two failed-preparation residue files by SHA with empty native output; original failure and lineage bytes remain. B3 requires fresh roots. O_EXCL claim and failure record prevent silent repeat.
Three literal in-memory replacements, exact inverse and AST equality; only verified_candidate and prepare are compiled. No global filesystem hook or scientific function replacement.

Wrapper command, authorization, five adapter sources, six original sources, exact registration, original failure audit, wait/launch and stdout/stderr are bound in separate revision receipts. Original native registration is not rewritten.

close requires strict wait0, false interruption flags, null metadata error, matching exact argv and PID/start/host, actual child/parent gone. guard on leo consumes pinned main-host closure and never interprets local absence of remote PID as gone.
Unknown current native/control/DINO failures reject; only exact historical B2 metadata failure SHA is retired by separate guard. Root must retain all original downstream stage gates.
limitations: This is engineering eligibility only. No B2 native scientific result, DINO selection, B3 seven-metric result or final report is established by this review.
Root still owns original-environment qualification, exact static deployment, immutable authorization, one metadata prepare, real close wait and explicit downstream dispatch.
Downstream metadata guard must be recorded as additional evidence; it does not authorize automatic scientific retry or bypass budgets.
